Handover reason: Hello Frank,  Currently there is no active error. But the customer complain same issue like
( ID 0480016).
Please try same troubleshooting.
this error flag can be caused by network-related issues such as a defective or disconnected network cable, a faulty network switch, or power supply problems with the payment terminal. It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured. Additionally, ensuring all connections are secure and swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help identify if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows: Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2  1.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process

afonso-sousa@siemens.com
